filter_disclosure.note: Quality filters are a project filter choice; they do not make MODIS and VIIRS detection performance equivalent.

stage1.unit: Observation event of one platform in one 0.1° WGS84 grid cell
stage1.grid_rule: col = floor((lon_e5 + 18,000,000) / R), row = floor((lat_e5 + 9,000,000) / R), R = grid × 100,000 (same rule as the map grid)
stage1.measurement: Number of FIRMS detections of that platform in the cell during the event (each sensor its own count).
stage1.filters_applied: Shared PyroSync filters: dates, AOI (exact polygon, before aggregation), MODIS confidence, VIIRS confidence, fire type, day/night.
stage1.sensor_note: MODIS (~1 km at nadir) and VIIRS I-band (375 m) pixels differ in size and sensitivity; values are kept per sensor and never added.

class_doc.matched: Candidate match: a MODIS event and a VIIRS event in the same cell within the time tolerance. Both sensors reported at least one detection. This is a positive-detection match, not verified joint coverage.
class_doc.viirs_only_proxy: VIIRS event without a MODIS partner, while MODIS reported a detection within the evidence radius and time tolerance (the instrument was imaging nearby). Proxy only: the cell may have been outside the swath or under cloud.
class_doc.viirs_only_no_evidence: VIIRS event without a MODIS partner and with no MODIS detection nearby in time. Whether MODIS observed the cell is unknown; such units are never used as MODIS zeros.
class_doc.modis_only_proxy: MODIS event without a VIIRS partner, while VIIRS reported a detection within the evidence radius and time tolerance. Proxy only, as above.
class_doc.modis_only_no_evidence: MODIS event without a VIIRS partner and no VIIRS detection nearby in time. Coverage unknown.

stage2.matching_rule: Events: consecutive acquisitions of one platform in one cell ≤ 20 min apart. Candidate pair: MODIS and VIIRS events in the same cell with |Δt| ≤ 30 min (event time = first acquisition). One-to-one greedy matching by (|Δt|, MODIS time, VIIRS time, cell): deterministic and independent of input order.

coverage_verification.note: Verified satellite coverage is NOT established. FIRMS active-fire records list detections only; they do not say which cells each overpass imaged, nor which were cloud-free. Verifying coverage would require swath geolocation and fire/cloud masks (MOD03/MOD14 for MODIS, VNP03/VNP14 or VJ103/VJ114 for VIIRS), which PyroSync does not import. 'Proxy' classes only show that the other instrument reported a detection nearby at about the same time.

stage2.warning: Terra crosses the equator at about 10:30/22:30 local time and VIIRS at about 13:30/01:30, so few or no Terra–VIIRS events fall within a short tolerance. Aqua is the near-simultaneous partner for VIIRS.

stage3.equation: ln(1 + M_i) = α + β ln(1 + V_i) + ε_i
stage3.prediction: M̂_i = max(0, exp(α̂ + β̂ ln(1 + V_i)) − 1)
stage3.estimator: Ordinary least squares on the training (earlier) period only
stage3.reason: Only 0 comparison units; at least 40 are needed (30 training + 10 held-out). Widen the dates or AOI, or increase the tolerance.

interpretation: MODIS is used as the reference scale for continuity with the long MODIS record; it is not ground truth. Its own omission and commission errors remain in the target.

The calibration maps a VIIRS measurement to an expected MODIS-scale measurement for the same cell and overpass. It does not make the sensors equivalent and does not recover fires that neither sensor detected.
With unit_set = 'matched', the model is conditional on both sensors reporting a detection; it does not describe cells where only one sensor detected fire.
Coefficients are empirical for this AOI, period, filters and sensor pair. Re-fit before applying them elsewhere.
Standard errors assume independent units; neighbouring cells and successive days are correlated, so the intervals are optimistic.

validity.label: Not validated for application with this configuration

checks.label: Model fitted
checks.value: Only 0 comparison units; at least 40 are needed (30 training + 10 held-out). Widen the dates or AOI, or increase the tolerance.
checks.rule: At least 30 training and 10 held-out units, and a non-constant VIIRS value.

checks.label: Measurement eligible for application
checks.rule: Only detection counts may be applied. FRP sums are evaluated but never applied: on the full Indonesia archive the log-log model did not reduce held-out FRP errors (docs/HARMONIZATION_VALIDATION.md, run E).

validity.scope: Valid only for the AOI, dates, filters, sensor pair, grid, tolerance and unit set of this run. Calibrated values before the held-out period are in-sample. Satellite coverage is not verified, and MODIS is a reference scale, not ground truth.
validity.applies_to: Map estimates and time series in the Harmonization tab. The calendar, history, Explore map and Sensor Workbench always show original observations.
